aPlusContent.title: From the manufacturer
aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
50dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation 
Immerse yourself in a world of uninterrupted sound with segment-leading ANC technology for neckbands. With an impressive 50dB noise reduction, escape the chaos of noisy surroundings and enjoy audio in its purest form. Rediscover every beat, every moment, in absolute serenity. 
Up to 38 hours of playback with fast charging 
Enjoy an impressive 38 hours of battery life and leave frequent charging worries behind. With Dart Charge, power up for 20 hours of music in just 10 minutes of charging, keeping your tunes going without interruption. 
360° spatial audio effect 
Immerse yourself in a theater-like experience where sound surrounds you from every angle. With the incredible 360° spatial audio effect, dive into a realistic three-dimensional sonic journey that elevates your senses to extraordinary heights. 
13.6mm Dynamic Bass Driver 
Introducing our revolutionary 13.6mm dynamic bass driver—the largest for in-ear headphones. Equipped with a titanized diaphragm, it delivers crystal-clear mid and high frequencies while producing deep, resonating bass. Get ready for an immersive audio experience that elevates your senses and redefines your listening journey.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought the realme Buds Wireless 2 after watching many reviews, and honestly, it turned out to be one of my best purchases. The sound quality is excellent, with punchy bass and a very good overall sound profile. The mic quality is also great, and calls are quite clear.Bluetooth connectivity is strong, and the realme Link app is very useful for customization. It is also comfortable for long hours and has good build quality—I’ve dropped it a few times, but it still works perfectly.Overall, a fantastic product from realme. Totally worth it

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Good product, but durability needs improvement
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The ANC performance is good, but after around 1 year of use, I started facing issues. The ANC stopped working properly, and one side developed a constant electronic/buzzing noise that does not go away while using the device.I previously used the same brand's Wireless 3 (previous generation) for around 2 years, and it worked without any major issues.Compared with the previous generation, I expected better durability from this one. Good ANC and features, but long-term reliability needs improvement.
